name: mod-builder
description: Build Claude Code mods spec-first (interview → SPEC → approve → build → verify), and watch them come together in Mod Lab: a pane, band, status line and toasts tracking every mod's pipeline.

modsDir.title: Mods folder
modsDir.description: The folder whose child folders are the mods Mod Lab tracks. Set, it always wins. Empty: the mods folder a build reports (a marketplace's mods/ in the project's own git repository: its top folder or one of its worktrees), else the mods/ of the marketplace nearest the session's project root (a git worktree's own after /cd), else nearest the working directory, else the one beside this plugin.

autoOpen.title: Open Mod Lab when Claude reports a build stage
autoOpen.description: Open the Mod Lab pane when a skill reports a running stage. Claude Code shows it then only in a window at least 144 columns wide (110 once you have opened Mod Lab yourself). Typing /mod-builder:build or /mod-builder:edit opens Mod Lab whatever this is set to.

autoRerun.title: Re-run stale checks after each turn
autoRerun.description: When a mod's code changes after Validate or Test passed, re-run them at the end of Claude's turn (Validate first, then Test if it passes).

testTimeoutMinutes.title: Check time limit (minutes)
testTimeoutMinutes.description: A Validate, Test or type-check still running after this many minutes is stopped and shown as timed out. At most 10.

logging.title: Logging
logging.description: off: nothing. normal: errors, session start and check results. verbose: also reports, scans, processes and commands. debug: also expected misses, lights and process output. Written to ~/.claude/mod-builder-data/logs/ and the debug log.
